# Go Report Card

The badge is generated by the [Go Report Card workflow](https://github.com/soulteary/owlmail/actions/workflows/go-reportcard.yml).
Each run records the exact analyzed commit as `github.sha`; open the workflow
run to inspect its logs, score, and source revision.

This tracked page intentionally does not copy generated source line numbers,
because they become stale as code moves. The workflow keeps only the compact
SVG badge in Git, while the required test workflows remain the authoritative
merge gate.
